Why Ollama cannot load Ornith

Ornith GGUFs declare general.architecture = qwen35 (dense) or qwen35moe (MoE, 256 experts, 8 active). Ollama 0.13.5 bundles a llama.cpp that knows qwen3 and qwen3moe only — the strings qwen35 and qwen35moe do not appear in its binary at all.

Hybrid attention/SSM

full_attention_interval=4 means one layer in four is full attention; the rest carry constant-size SSM state (ssm.state_size=128, conv_kernel=4). That is why 131k context costs a few GB rather than tens.

MTP

blk.N.nextn.* tensors are present but llama.cpp logs them as unused, so multi-token prediction gives no speculative speedup today.
